spectral_edges.reading_rule: Three-hourly resolved variance at three wet nodes; Hs>=0.1 m enters the criterion. The lowest two intervals must contain <0.1% of variance, the highest two <1%, with the peak inside the band. The printed band excludes SWAN's diagnostic high-frequency tail.

refinement_window.selection: Seven-day window containing the largest basin-mean stress in the reporting cycle, with 96 preceding hours and the first selected day excluded

refined_spectral_edges.reading_rule: Three-hourly resolved variance at three wet nodes; Hs>=0.1 m enters the criterion. The lowest two intervals must contain <0.1% of variance, the highest two <1%, with the peak inside the band. The printed band excludes SWAN's diagnostic high-frequency tail.
